review.method: Compared exact official release source packages/mcp/src and package.json; inspected published tarball metadata, LICENSE and executable file inventory, network and telemetry paths, installed lifecycle-hook declarations, lock dependency metadata.
sourceDelta: Research-preview feedback tool and POST /api/v2/feedback added, gated behind --research-preview or CONTEXT7_RESEARCH_PREVIEW; neither is forwarded by this launcher.
OAuth-client registration telemetry classification added; existing OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true short-circuits telemetry implementation loading.
API keys are trimmed and unresolved environment placeholders are rejected; normal DPAPI API key input remains compatible.
Empty resolve results preserve teamspace library-filter notice.
Existing resolve-library-id and query-docs input schemas and MCP SDK direct dependency versions unchanged.

network.newFeedbackOperationDisabled: POST /v2/feedback; preview registration false because clean child environment excludes CONTEXT7_RESEARCH_PREVIEW and launcher takes no arguments
network.oauth: No setup/OAuth invoked. Stdio API-key path used; HTTP-only OAuth metadata routes not started; initialize capabilities remain empty so auth elicitation is unavailable.
network.telemetry: Inherited childEnvironment keeps OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true, OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=none and CTX7_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; telemetryIsDisabled checks OTEL_SDK_DISABLED. No HTTP transport or metrics listener requested.
network.requestMetadata: Existing vendor behavior sends SDK/client/transport/session metadata with authorized public documentation requests. Research-preview header remains absent.

preserved: existing mcp configuration and tool allowlist
review.launcherChangeReason: Legacy context7.ts owns a hardcoded MCP 4.4.4 pin and is explicitly out of scope. Launcher now validates the same package name/version/bin contract locally against isolated 4.5.1; shared DPAPI, environment, validation and sanitization helpers remain unchanged.
review.existingAcceptance: runtime/context7-acceptance.ts launches context7-mcp.ts fresh and asserts exactly the two existing tool names before resolve/query; no hardcoded MCP version assumption required modification.

rollback.activation: Restart MCP through parent after acceptance; existing running process was not terminated.

acceptanceForParent.credentialSafety: Existing acceptance invokes launcher with DPAPI intake and sanitized output; no credential CLI argument or echo. Uses real vendor documentation calls only when parent runs it.
parentMustConfirm: tools/list contains only resolve-library-id and query-docs

nonblockingAttempts: GitHub API source compare returned HTTP 403; resolved with exact commit archives and local no-index diff.
First npm lock attempt used NUL for both user/global config and was rejected before config resolution; distinct nonexistent global config path succeeded.
notPerformed: No vendor API requests or runtime smoke
